description: Daily reports of newly found startups. Two kinds. report="network" is the Frontrun Report: every new startup found across the whole Frontrun network that day (Pro and Max); each company says in_your_sectors when it is in the sectors you picked in onboarding. report="list" is the report from only the accounts YOU track. Leave report out and you get the one your account is emailed each morning. Filter by date range and sector. "Show me last week's stablecoin discoveries across the network."

cursor.description: Opaque watermark from a previous response's next_cursor. Picks up from the day after the newest report already returned, so a repeating job never re-reads or skips one. Cannot be combined with date.

report.description: "network" = the Frontrun Report, every new startup across the whole network (Pro and Max). "list" = only what the accounts you track found. Default: the report your account is emailed.

name: frontrun_reports
